fact: A contract award notice dated 13 August 2026 records the technical advisory service for renewing Somalia's National ICT Policy and Strategy (2019-2024) as a 2025-2029 policy as awarded; it names no winner and no adopted policy.
title: Awarded - National ICT Policy and Strategy for (2025-2029) Technical Advisory Service for Renewing the existing Somalia's National ICT Policy and Strategy for (2019-2024)
